summary: Dark call-to-action section with glows (or brand gradient) that closes a landing page: eyebrow, title, description, actions, and optional numbered steps in an ordered list that adapts to the container width.
whenToUse: Final call to action on a community landing page: call for speakers, sign-up, becoming a mentor or organizer.
Explain in a few numbered steps what happens after the click.
whenNotToUse: Welcome or summary at the top of a dashboard: use HeroCard (brand/accent/subtle surface, with media).
Compact, fully clickable promotion (a single link or button): use PromoBanner.
Sign-up with an email field: use NewsletterCard.
Interactive procedure with step status: use Stepper.

props.name: title
props.description: Title; also gives the region its name.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Chip above the title (campaign, date, category).

props.name: variant
props.description: dark: inverse surface with glows; brand: accent gradient.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).
accessibility: It is a <section> named by its title (aria-labelledby).
Steps are an ordered list (<ol>): numbering comes from the semantics; the visible number is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
Text always uses the foreground paired with the surface (text-inverse on dark, action-primary-foreground on brand): contrast is guaranteed in light and dark themes.
Glows and gradients are decorative and are removed in forced-colors mode, where borders and numbers use CanvasText.
responsive: Container query on the panel: from 48rem, text and steps sit side by side, with steps in a column.
Below 48rem the steps go below the text in an auto-fit grid (a row when there is room, a column in narrow containers); works down to 320px.
Padding and title size shrink in narrow containers.
customization: Tokens: --dc-color-surface-inverse / --dc-color-text-inverse (dark), --dc-gradient-accent and --dc-color-action-primary-foreground (brand), --dc-color-action-primary and --dc-color-accent-default for the glows, --dc-look-radius-container.
commonMistakes: Using ghost or outline buttons on the brand variant: their color is not designed for the gradient; prefer secondary.
Writing numbers in step titles: numbering is automatic.
Placing multiple CtaPanels on the same page: they lose effectiveness; keep one per landing page.

limits: In the dark theme the dark variant becomes a light panel (inverse surface) to keep contrast with the page.
Steps are informational: for states (completed, current) use Stepper.
